android.desc:
Bitrix24 is an all-in-one online workspace that helps you run your entire business from your phone. From sales and marketing to HR and automation, Bitrix24 brings 35+ business tools into one mobile app – so your work moves forward wherever you are.

CRM
Capture and manage leads from every channel
Track deals, contacts, and interactions in one place
Build long-term customer relationships with less effort

TASKS & PROJECTS
Plan work with lists, Kanban, Gantt, or Scrum
Assign tasks, deadlines, and owners easily
Keep projects on track from anywhere

AI ASSISTANT
Generate ideas and write texts
Get call transcripts + summaries
Autocomplete fields in CRM

TEAM MESSENGER
Chat instantly with individuals or teams
Share files, tasks, and links in conversations
Keep work communication fast and organized

VIDEO CONFERENCING
Host video calls with teams or clients
Share screens and collaborate live
Stay connected wherever you work

SALES AUTOMATION
Automate lead routing and deal stages
Trigger follow-ups and reminders automatically
Close deals faster with less manual work

MARKETING
Launch email campaigns in minutes
Reach customers via WhatsApp messaging
Track engagement and campaign results

BOOKING
Let clients book appointments online
Sync schedules automatically
Reduce no-shows with reminders

INVOICING & E-SIGNATURES
Create and send invoices instantly
Collect legally binding e-signatures
Speed up approvals and payments

FILE STORAGE & ONLINE DOCUMENTS
Store files securely in the cloud
Collaborate on documents in real time
Access your work from any device

HR MANAGEMENT
Manage employee profiles and records
Track working hours and attendance
Automate HR workflows and requests

WORKFLOW AUTOMATION
Automate repetitive business processes
Connect actions across teams and tools
Reduce errors and save time

ANALYTICS
Monitor performance with real-time data
Track KPIs across departments
Make smarter, data-driven decisions

You can also access Bitrix24 from your desktop computer or laptop (via browser).

Loved and trusted by over 15,000,000 organizations around the world, Bitrix24 may become a growth platform for your company as well. Just give it a try.

Got any problems, questions, or suggestions? Head over to https://helpdesk.bitrix24.com/ for more information.
